semantic_fragments.content: US National Differences - Clause 4.8b: Replacement: where there was no relevant IEC/ISO standard, the relevant US ANSI standard applied. When no relevant US ANSI standard existed, the requirements of this standard applied. Result: Replaced. See appended table 8.10 in main report. Verdict: P.

US National Differences - Clause 4.10.2: Replacement: Rated voltage not exceeding 250V dc or single phase ac, or 600V poly-phase ac for ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS up to 4kVA. Rated voltage not exceeding 600V for all other ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS. Addition: The protective measures as described in IEC 60364-4-41 and the NEC. Result for device: Internally powered. Verdict: N/A for all sub-items.

US National Differences - Clause 6.6: Addition: To comply with NFPA 70, X-Ray systems are classified as long time operation (> 5 min) or momentary operation (< 5 sec). Result: Not an X-Ray system. Verdict: N/A.
US National Differences - Clause 7.2.11: Addition: To comply with NFPA 70, X-Ray systems are marked as long time operation or momentary operation. Verdict: N/A.

US National Differences - Clause 7.2.22: New Sub-clause: Colors of medical gas cylinders. To comply with NFPA 99: Cylinders containing medical gases and their connection points are colored in accordance with the requirements of NFPA 99. Result: No medical gas cylinders. Verdict: N/A.
US National Differences - Clause 8.2: Addition: All FIXED ME EQUIPMENT & PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT are CLASS I ME EQUIPMENT. Result: Portable equipment. Verdict: N/A.
End of IEC 60601-1 Test Report section. Report continues with Attachment 1: US National Differences and Attachment 2: Photo Documentation.
